doc.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002

title: Listening to records: Oliver Nelson
summary: Quick takes with Oliver Nelson's easy writing.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well I promised I would play a couple of pieces that you’re on and see if you can recall the session.
Oh I know what that is. That was with Oliver Nelson. Right.

Those were nice. We got through those quickly. I remember we used to do them second take at least, no further than that on all these things that I did with Oliver. But he wrote in such a way that it wasn’t that complicated, it wasn’t difficult and we used to do it. I hate to have to do a lot of takes in a recording session.
Yeah. They don’t get better, right?
No, they start going down hill after a while. That’s a good record.
Yeah. Here’s something a little more recent.
